photos.title: Oak Forest from above
photos.what: Oak Forest from above (USDA NAIP aerial photo, 2023): straight streets of small detached houses, one house to a small lot, with a strip of pine woods along the east side.
photos.caption: Part of Oak Forest from the air: one house to a small lot, along straight streets.
photos.alt: Aerial photo of part of Oak Forest in Myrtle Beach: rows of small detached houses on small lots along straight streets, with pine woods along one side
photos.author: USDA Farm Service Agency, NAIP
photos.provenance: U.S. government aerial photo: USDA National Agriculture Imagery Program (NAIP), South Carolina 2023, natural color, 60 cm. Exported by Chapter3 from the USGS National Map NAIP image service (exportImage, Web Mercator, cubic resampling, mosaic locked to Year=2023) on 2026-11-15; the exact request is in source_request.
photos.license_note: Same source and terms as the NAIP records of /submarkets/garden-city/ (data/2026-11-a/submarkets-garden-city/photos.json): The National Map offers free downloads of public domain NAIP orthoimagery; the USDA FSA policy page says public domain information may be freely distributed or copied, with credit requested.
photos.credit: Photo: USDA Farm Service Agency, NAIP, public domain, via The National Map (USGS).
photos.changes: Chapter3 Realty cut this view from the NAIP service
photos.subject_check: Looked at full size by the writer of /submarkets/myrtle-beach/oak-forest/ on 2026-11-15, with the county's parcel lines drawn over it. Almost every house outline in the frame (102 of 106 on the county's map of buildings) is on an Oak Forest lot; the other 4 are warehouse roofs at the top left corner. No person; no readable sign, plate or house number at page size.
photos.crop_note: Crops cut from the center of a second export of the same frame at 1800 x 1350 (crop_source_request) by tools/photos.js crops, for Article.image and the share image.
